subtitle: A refuge needs neighbors, not another war.

briefing.text: The attempt to live beside the villages has become an open battle. After the bloodshed, the households can no longer persuade the patrol to stand down. Orin’s company must break the remaining patrol to leave, and will face the Master without Dain’s help.

Orin’s company has found empty houses beside living villages. Captain Dain has orders to drive the dead away; the villagers want time to judge their new neighbors for themselves. Orin will defend the refuge while they gather. Helping the sick can win their support sooner, but any death would destroy the chance of peace.

hints.text: Defend ownership of the refuge through six enemy turns. Troops can leave the ruins to screen it; enemy recapture resets the count. Medicine reduces the defense to five turns.
Skeleton clubs punish the armored patrol. Bone bows answer its unarmored swordsmen, archers and adepts; protect those bows with a melee screen.
Nonlethal defensive attacks are allowed. Any death ends mediation; check the combat preview before attacking and leave withdrawing men a way home.
The patrol still has somewhere to run.
The empty houses remain, even after peace is lost.

intro.text: These houses are empty. The people next door are not. We could be neighbors, if they let us stay.
My orders say the dead must leave. My patrol is coming to enforce them.

intro.speaker: Village elder
intro.text: Give us six days to gather the households. Defend your shelter if you must, but let men who turn back go home. There are sick families here who need the herbs in the northern grove.
Then we hold our ground. We will not hunt your wounded. And we will bring the medicine.
